cases.name: refcnt
cases.note: The distinct owner-local test preserves the pinned construction, retain/unretain actions, null-safe calls, and five ordered count assertions through the retained RefCnt owner.

cases.name: rcp
cases.note: The distinct owner-local test preserves every pinned null, construction, copy, release, reset, conversion, move, equality, field, and reference-count assertion in source order through the retained rcp owner.

adaptation.rationale: Pinned C++ expresses A/B polymorphism with inheritance and implicit converting rcp constructors/assignment; Rust expresses the same layout-compatible CRTP owner and ownership transfers with repr(C), embedded RefCnt, and explicit retained conversion constructors.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: C++ inheritance syntax and implicit overload selection; the pointee fields, pointer identities, moves, and intrusive reference counts remain observable and are asserted.
